rows.note: Use 電力 for electricity or an electricity supply, especially when discussing power cuts or equipment.

example.english: This machine cannot work without power.
example.traditional: 呢部機冇電力就開唔到。
example.jyutping: ni1 bou6 gei1 mou5 din6 lik6 zau6 hoi1 m4 dou2

rows.note: Use 權力 for the ability to control or influence people, including formal political, legal, or business authority.

example.english: People with power shouldn't abuse it.
example.traditional: 有權力嘅人唔應該亂咁用權。
example.jyutping: jau5 kyun4 lik6 ge3 jan4 m4 jing1 goi1 lyun6 gam3 jung6 kyun4

rows.note: Use 能力 as the all-purpose noun for someone's ability or capacity to do something.

example.english: I have the power to handle it myself.
example.jyutping: ngo5 jau5 nang4 lik6 zi6 gei2 gaau2 dim6

rows.note: Use 力量 for physical strength or force, rather than 能力 or 權力.

example.english: This punch has a lot of power.
example.jyutping: ni1 kyun4 ge3 lik6 loeng6 hou2 daai6
